name: en-301-549-online
description: Build and test tooling for the EN 301 549 Online accessible HTML edition. The site is generated by scripts/build.py (Python 3 stdlib), which shells out to scripts/minify-assets.mjs (terser + csso, pinned here) for production CSS/JS minification. The remaining devDependencies are the checks Python can't do on its own: static HTML/ARIA conformance (html-validate) and real-browser sweeps (Playwright: axe-core accessibility, responsive layout, search, theme, module-failure and performance-budget checks).

scripts.test: python3 -m unittest scripts/test_build.py && python3 scripts/check-contrast.py && npm run build && html-validate "docs/*.html"
